variants.longDescription:

Back neck tape with loop
Nylon coil zip with metal puller and cord ending
Set-in sleeves
Softshell welt pockets with hidden zip

Softshell fabric at outer collar and yoke
Brushed polar fleece fabric with anti-pilling on both sides
Internal concealed zip at left chest for easy decoration access

Herringbone back neck tape
Self-fabric half-moon at back neck
Round drawcord in matching colour with closed-end metal tipping
Metal eyelets
Kangaroo pocket
Set-in sleeves
1x1 rib at sleeve cuffs and hem
Twin-needle topstitching at armholes, sleeve cuffs and hem
